Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 15
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed the earliest release dates for the two films—swapping them. Despite IMDb data showing Tiger of the Seven Seas earliest release as Italy, December 23, 1962, and My Wife’s Lodger earliest release as UK, October 1952, the Planner reversed these, concluding Tiger of the Seven Seas was earlier. This misreading of the retrieved sources directly led to the incorrect final answer.
